releases.synopsis: Mad Money is an American finance television program hosted by Jim Cramer that began airing on CNBC on March 14, 2005. Its main focus is investment and speculation, particularly in publicly traded stocks. In a notable departure from the CNBC programming style prior to its arrival, Mad Money presents itself in an entertainment-style format rather than a news broadcasting one. Cramer defines "mad money" as the money one "can use to invest in stocks ... not retirement money, which you want in 401K or an IRA, a savings account, bonds, or the most conservative of dividend-paying stocks." Mad Money replaced Dylan Ratigan's Bullseye for the 6 p.m. Eastern Time slot. On January 8, 2007, CNBC began airing reruns of the show at 11 p.m. Eastern Time, on Monday through Friday, and at 4 a.m. Eastern Time, on Saturdays.In March 2012, the program became a part of what was formerly branded as NBC All Night in the nominal 3:07 a.m. ET/2:07 a.m. timeslot on weeknights, replacing week-delayed repeats of NBC's late night talk shows. In that form, only the video for the program was presented on a 16:9 screen with gray branded windowboxing andpillarboxing, with all enhanced business information, including the CNBC Ticker, removed. Because of the scheduling of local station's 4 a.m. or 4:30 a.m. newscasts to airEarly Today depending on how a station schedules its overnight programming (even if it airs at the regular time in the Eastern and Pacific time zones for instance, seven minutes would have to be cut-off to fit in Early Today and a local newscast starting at 4:30 a.m.), it is subject to local pre-emption, including by NBC O&O's.On August 4, 2014, Mad Money was first broadcast in full 1080i HD, resulting in the removal of the sidebar that was seen on all of CNBC's other trading-day programming, until the sidebar itself was permanently removed altogether on October 13, 2014. The NBC presentation displays the native widescreen HD picture, albeit with the CNBC Ticker space still filled in with gray windowboxing.

releases.synopsis: 8 singles agreed to participate in an experiment in which they get married in an arranged marriage with a person they've never met before. They are matched up with each other by an expert panel consisting of a priest, two psychologists and anthropologists who have studied a large group of Danish singles to find the perfect match.

releases.title: Big Brother
releases.synopsis: American version of the reality game show which follows a group of HouseGuests living together 24 hours a day in the "Big Brother" house, isolated from the outside world but under constant surveillance with no privacy for three months.

releases.title: FOX & Friends First
releases.synopsis: Kicking off the day, FOX & Friends First delivers all the headlines viewers may have missed overnight, along with a preview of upcoming news events. Presented two hours before FOX & Friends, the first hour of the program is hosted by Todd Piro and Carley Shimkus

releases.title: Home and Away
releases.synopsis: Home and Away is set in the fictional town of Summer Bay, a coastal town in New South Wales, and follows the personal and professional lives of the people living in the area. The show initially focused on the Fletcher family, Pippa and Tom Fletcher and their five foster children Frank Morgan, Carly Morris, Steven Matheson, Lynn Davenport and Sally Keating, who would go on to become one of the show's longest-running characters. The show also originally and currently focuses on the Stewart family. Home and Away had proved popular when it premiered in 1988 and had risen to become a hit in Australia, and after only a few weeks, the show tackled its first major and disturbing storyline, the rape of Carly Morris; it was one of the first shows to feature such storylines during the early timeslot. H&A has tackled many adult-themed and controversial storylines; something rarely found in its restricted timeslot.

releases.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
releases.synopsis: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe covers all the breaking business news and top stories in the lead-up to the opening of the European markets!

releases.title: Making Money with Charles Payne
releases.synopsis: Long-time Wall Street broker and analyst Charles Payne hosts his own daily program Making Money with Charles Payne that helps viewers spot emerging investment prospects. A panel of business and market specialists joins him to discuss the latest headlines, wrap up the day's activities in the markets, and focus on tomorrow's moneymakers. Payne says, "There are money-making opportunities behind every headline." His goal is to help viewers "find their confidence in the markets and realize their long-term dreams and goals."

releases.title: Big Brother: The Group Chat
releases.synopsis: As Big Brother returns this autumn on ITV2 and ITVX for its biggest series yet, Big Brother: The Group Chat will give fans even more action, bringing them closer to the personalities, dynamics and relationships at the heart of the series. With exclusive interviews with evicted Housemates, celebrity fans and special guests, viewers can expect strong opinions, plenty of personality and the inside scoop from those who know the house best.From the biggest moments to the hot topics sparking conversation, Kate and GK will be on hand to dissect the drama, celebrate the stand-out scenes and weigh in on the decisions and surprises shaping the game. Whether it's an unexpected shake-up, an unlikely alliance or a moment that has everyone talking, Big Brother: The Group Chat will be the place to continue the conversation after Big Brother each night.

releases.title: CBS Mornings
releases.synopsis: CBS Mornings offers a thoughtful, substantive and insightful source of news and information to a daily audience of 3 million viewers. The Emmy Award-winning broadcast presents a mix of daily news, coverage of developing stories of national and global significance, and interviews with leading figures in politics, business and entertainment.

metadata.episode_name: Jacob Tremblay, Mark Adam Hyman, Chef Nora LaTorre

releases.title: Today 3rd Hour
releases.synopsis: A news program intended to inform, entertain, inspire and set the agenda each morning. Each daily live broadcast provides current domestic and international news, weather reports, and interviews with newsmakers from the worlds of politics, business, media, entertainment and sports.

metadata.episode_name: William Jackson Harper, Paul Walter Hauser, Kenny Chesney

releases.title: Korpset
releases.synopsis: Who can handle the extreme physical and mental challenges of becoming an elite soldier? Watch as the aspirants are tested for eight grueling days.

releases.title: Against the Current
releases.synopsis: Shen Jialan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jinqi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jinqi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

releases.title: The Pulse
releases.synopsis: Francine Lacqua provides commentary and analysis on the developing stories from around Europe along with a look-ahead to what's likely to dominate the US business agenda.

releases.title: The Briefing with Jen Psaki
releases.synopsis: Based in Washington, D.C., The Briefing with Jen Psaki will pull from Psaki's decades-long experiences on campaign buses, in the Oval Office, at the State Department, and in the briefing room to dissect the most important stories of the day. Every day the show will aim to help viewers better understand the happenings in Washington and around the country, how it impacts their communities, and what leaders are doing to stand up for the people they represent.

releases.title: CNN NewsNight with Abby Phillip
releases.synopsis: In CNN NewsNight with Abby Phillip, she delivers a thoughtful, sharp approach to the day's biggest stories.

releases.title: Scènes de ménages
releases.synopsis: Scènes de ménages depicts the daily lives of several couples from different generations, illustrating with humor their arguments, tender moments and little idiosyncrasies. Each episode is made up of short sketches, in which the characters exchange scathing retorts and funny situations.

releases.title: Varney & Company
releases.synopsis: Varney & Company is hosted by veteran business journalist Stuart Varney, noted for his distinctive British accent, hosts this weekday morning program on which he and his guests discuss the implications of political news on the business world, and also how the news of the day affects personal finances. The company Varney keeps includes regular contributors Charles Payne, Sandra Smith and Elizabeth MacDonald, who weigh in on such issues as government spending, health care and bailouts.

releases.title: Al Rojo Vivo
releases.synopsis: Al Rojo Vivo is a news magazine that in one hour, takes viewers on a journey through the world. It is an "information paella" that offers something for everyone: local and international news, entertainment, fashion, live interviews, special investigations, human interest, health, consumer alerts and new technology.

releases.title: Fast Money
releases.synopsis: Fast Money is a lively hour of exchange and debate takes place among four of Wall Street's leading traders. Segments include a look at the day's business-related stories in Page Two; the Takedown, in which panelists disagree and argue their points; the Chart of the Day, which offers a look at the stock of the day; and Trade School, in which host Melissa Lee defines Wall Street jargon used by a panelist or a guest.

releases.title: El hormiguero
releases.synopsis: El Hormiguero is a Spanish television program with a live audience focusing on comedy, science, and politics running since September 2006. It is hosted and produced by screenwriter Pablo Motos. The show aired on Spain's Cuatro channel from launch until June 2011 and is now broadcast on Antena 3. Recurring guests on the show include Luis Piedrahita, Raquel Martos, Marron & "The Man in Black", and puppet ants Trancas and Barrancas. It has proved a ratings success, and has expanded from a weekly 120-minute show to a daily 40-minute show in its third season, which began on September 17, 2007. The show won the Entertainment prize at the 2009 Rose d'Or ceremony.

releases.title: Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power
releases.synopsis: In Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power, host David Gura focuses on the politics and policies being shaped by President Trump's administration.

releases.title: Spring of the Blade
releases.synopsis: Xie Qingyuan, orphaned at a young age, lived on the streets until she met Shen Run, who had been sent to the army after a family tragedy. They parted ways with a promise to survive, and Shen Run gave her a penny as a token. Years later, Xie Qingyuan returns to Xie Mansion, determined to uncover the truth about her mother's death. As Shen Run rises to power, he is assigned to oversee the Xie family during a crisis. While working together, the two rekindle their bond. Shen Run is drawn to Xie Qingyuan's courage, intelligence, and optimism, while she grows to trust him as a close ally and friend.

releases.title: Squawk Box
releases.synopsis: Squawk Box is a business news television program that airs at breakfast time on the CNBC network. The program is currently co-hosted by Joe Kernen, Rebecca Quick, and Andrew Ross Sorkin. Since debuting in 1995, the show has spawned a number of versions across CNBC's international channels, many of which employ a similar format. The program title originates from a term used in investment banks and stock brokerages for a permanent voice circuit or intercom used to communicate stock deals or sales priorities; it also may refer to the squawk of a bird, like a peacock, which is the logo of CNBC.

releases.title: NBC News Daily
releases.synopsis: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

releases.title: To Catch A Smuggler: Contraband Capture
releases.synopsis: CBP and HSI respond to a surge in cocaine trafficking across U.S. land borders and at sea, which leads to boat chases, arrests and record-setting seizures...

releases.title: Alchemy Supreme
releases.synopsis: In the ancient continent of medicine, countless races coexist, with alchemists revered. The Yin-Yang Alchemy God, Su Beihuang, poured his heart and soul into refining the Divine Pill, only to be betrayed by a beautiful woman and become one with the pill, hiding for a century. A hundred years later, his descendant, Su Beitian, suffers humiliation but resists fiercely, unexpectedly inheriting the Alchemy God's legacy and returning with overwhelming power! Awakening his dual-elemental martial veins of ice and fire, he re-cultivates the Alchemy God's techniques, becoming a young hero. As he investigates the truth behind his mother's disappearance, a series of conspiracies gradually surface. Witness Su Beitian overcome tribulations, unravel the ultimate martial arts, and become the supreme master of alchemy!

releases.title: Na Wspólnej
releases.synopsis:
Na Wspólnej is a Polish soap opera. It has been running since 2003 on the TVN channel as its flagship primetime weekday soap opera. It is loosely based on the German production Unter Uns and it follows the lives of the inhabitants of an apartment block in Wspólna Street, Warsaw. Episodes tend to last around 20 minutes. It is a Polish version of the Hungarian "Barátok közt".

The series is shot almost entirely in Warsaw and produced by the Polish branch of Freemantle Media. On 9 September 2008 it celebrated its 1000th episode; "Na Wspólnej" was the fourth Polish television series ever to achieve such status. A special episode was broadcast in which characters from some other of TVN's most popular shows visited Wspólna Street.

releases.title: Squawk on the Street
releases.synopsis: Squawk on the Street is headquartered live on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. We are there when the all-important opening bell rings every day. With our exclusive "Eye on the Floor" wireless cameras at the NYSE we take the viewer onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the biggest companies in the world trade. In addition, our exclusive "Tick by Tick" charts track the action of every trade of every stock. Our live market coverage doesn't stop on the corner of Wall and Broad Streets in lower Manhattan. We also have exclusive coverage from the floor of the CME Group in Chicago giving our viewers the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time. In addition, "Squawk on the Street" is also on the air when the closing bells ring throughout Europe. That final hour of European trading starting at 10:30am eastern has proven to be very volatile and has a major impact on all U.S. based markets.

releases.title: Fast Money Halftime Report
releases.synopsis: The hot trades in the market from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange.

releases.title: Power Lunch
releases.synopsis: Power Lunch takes you through the heart of the business day, focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock information. The show delves into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology -- any place where there's money to be made. The program features daily contributions from the Nasdaq MarketSite's Times Square studio and coverage from CNBC's Post 9 position on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange, as well as from CNBC's bureaus around the world. "Power Lunch" showcases the best stories of the day from CNBC's roster of digital and television journalists.

releases.title: Closing Bell
releases.synopsis: Anything can happen between the bells of the trading day. But what happens during the last hour could be what matters most. Hosted by CNBC's Scott Wapner, "Closing Bell" guides you through the most important hour of the trading day. The show takes a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting.Live coverage includes reports from the Chicago Board of Trade, New York Mercantile Exchange, NASDAQ and the NYSE. Analysts, money managers and CEOs explain their strategies, share opinions, and provide an inside perspective on breaking news stories.In addition, "Closing Bell" provides instant analysis of corporate profit reports, as soon as they break, during the quarterly earning seasons. Features include interviews with entrepreneurs, plus an inside-look at how executives and high-net-worth individuals spend their time and money.

releases.title: Pionek
releases.synopsis: Season 2 of https://www.tvmaze.com/shows/81434/slebodaA continuation of the Śleboda series, centering on anthropologist Anka Serafin and journalist Sebastian Strzygoń. This time, the story takes us to Upper Silesia.

releases.title: El Señor de los Cielos
releases.synopsis: Set in the 1990s, these are the life and times of Amado Carrillo Fuentes, a man who became the head of the Juárez cartel. Nicknamed “El Señor de los Cielos” (Lord of the Skies) because of the large fleet of airplanes he used to transport drugs, he was also known for washing more than $200 million through Colombia to finance his huge fleet. He is described as the most powerful drug trafficker of his time.

releases.title: Perfect World
releases.synopsis: Born into a unique world where villages fight to gain power and control, the main character, Shi Hao, is a genius blessed by the heavens born under the poorest of conditions. His clan, however, has a mysterious past. To rise up and become the genius he is meant to be, the clan goes through every effort to aid his cultivation as they battle through fanatical monsters and engage in power struggles with other clans. His journey will bring him through unknown lands until he is able to become a person that can truly shake the world.

releases.title: 5 News at 5
releases.synopsis: National and international news.

releases.title: Norges tøffeste
releases.synopsis: What does it mean to be tough? Jørgine puts 10 young people to the test, physically and mentally. They only have each other to rely on.

releases.title: Till I See You
releases.synopsis: Song Yi, a wealthy young man raised in Japan, travels to Northern China in search of answers about his father's past and unexpectedly becomes Xu Feiyu's temporary caregiver. Recovering from eye surgery with his eyes still covered in bandages, Feiyu slowly lowers his guard under Song Yi's domineering yet tender care. Before they can truly ""see"" each other, they have already fallen in love. But just as Feiyu is about to regain his sight, a devastating secret comes to light, forcing Song Yi to disappear without a word. Five years later, fate brings them together again. Can their unforgettable love finally be made whole?

releases.title: The Source with Kaitlan Collins
releases.synopsis: The Source with Kaitlan Collins - Kaitlan Collins chases the facts, asks the tough questions, and connects with her sources in primetime.

releases.title: Shixiong A Shixiong
releases.synopsis: After being reborn in ancient times before the Great God-Conferment War, Li Changshou became a small cultivator.To survive in the cruel Primordial Times, Li Changshou tries hard not to accumulate any karma. He always plans thoroughly before doing anything and never allows himself to walk into dangerous situations. He hides his trump cards well, trains himself in escape techniques, refines poisonous pills, and masters mystical abilities.Li Changshou originally planned to remain hidden and safe in the mountain until his ascension to immortality. However, everything changed one year when his master brought home a junior sister…

releases.title: Dark Matter
releases.synopsis: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

releases.title: Cold Hunt
releases.synopsis: Criminal investigator Li Yujing is temporarily assigned to assist female officer Yue Qingchuan in solving a series of child trafficking cases. During the investigation, he unexpectedly uncovers a lead connected to an armed robbery case he handled 13 years ago. Together, the two cross a 13-year gap, unfolding a hard-boiled manhunt across dual timelines.

releases.title: Squawk Box Europe
releases.synopsis: Squawk Box Europe has everything you need to prepare for the first trade. Steve Sedgwick, Karen Tso and Julianna Tatelbaum speak to CEOs and CFOs from across Europe and the UK to understand the most complex market dynamics. Join the debate, dissemination, and discussion around some of the most market-moving and complex stories of the moment and insights into making you money work around the news.

releases.title: Chronicles of the Sun
releases.synopsis: Claire is surprised when she gets arrested for the murder of her childhood friend after she returns to Montpellier.

releases.title: Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories
releases.synopsis: Join Thomas, Percy, Rosie and all their friends as they work together and form lasting bonds that help them overcome any obstacle.

releases.title: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle
releases.synopsis: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.

releases.title: Доктор Краснов
releases.synopsis: The brilliant diagnostic doctor Andrey Krasnov is losing his memory after a gunshot injury to his head. He doesn't remember the last ten years of his life and can no longer treat people. However, Krasnov is unable to completely abandon his beloved business, he is ready to work even as a nurse. It turns out to be difficult to start life anew: the hero learns with horror that during these ten years he has lost his family, the location of colleagues and the trust of his daughter. In order to restore his "lost" life bit by bit, he will have to relive the dramatic events of his past. To make a difficult choice between two women dear to him — his ex-wife Anna, whose divorce has been erased from his memory, and his colleague Dasha. And also to understand the strange story of the trials of a new experimental drug, which caused the death of a young patient.

releases.title: Koala's Diary
releases.synopsis: Koala writes about daily life, whether it's good or bad, happy or sad. Koala treats every day as a precious day.

releases.title: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds
releases.synopsis: Follow Captain Christopher Pike, Science Officer Spock and Number One in the years before Captain Kirk boarded the U.S.S. Enterprise, as they explore new worlds around the galaxy.

releases.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
releases.synopsis: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Kriti Gupta.

releases.title: The Moment with Katy Tur
releases.synopsis: The Moment with Katy Tur is designed to move beyond the immediate headlines to provide deeper context and understanding of the political and national stories shaping the day.

releases.title: The Weeknight
releases.synopsis: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.

releases.title: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
releases.synopsis: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

releases.title: Большая фарма
releases.synopsis: Medical scientists Alexander Gireev and Vladimir Shulgin have invented a medicine that can cure any disease, even a cancerous tumor. But the drug that could save the world becomes a source of conflict for the entire family. Gireev's eldest son, Evgeny, decides to help his father with its promotion. His daughter, Polina, is convinced that her brother only wants fame and money, and he is ready to betray his father. And Gireev himself turns out to be unprepared for the compromises that the big‑pharma market demands of him. After all, producing medicines is a profitable business. And why produce something that will cure people if you can make more money while they're sick?

releases.title: Mornings with FOX Business
releases.synopsis: This early show that features a roundtable of rotating industry experts alongside the host. Guests discuss news stories -- domestic and international -- and other topics that are expected to impact the economy and markets that day. The show's intent is to give viewers a jump-start on making moves to get the most out of their investments.

releases.title: CBS News 24/7
releases.synopsis: Live news and top stories on CBS News 24/7.

releases.title: Current with Christine Romans
releases.synopsis: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

releases.title: Big Day with Peter Schrager
releases.synopsis: Big Day with Peter Schrager will originate from New York City and cover the biggest stories from across the sports world each day, blending reporting, interviews, unique perspectives and authentic conversations with the athletes, coaches, executives and personalities driving the day's biggest headlines. While fans can expect Schrager's trademark NFL insight and relationships, Big Day is built to celebrate the full sports landscape and the moments everyone will be talking about.

releases.title: State of Play with Peter Alexander
releases.synopsis: State of Play focuses on authoritative and original reporting, thoughtful conversations, and in-depth analysis of the biggest political and national stories shaping the day,

releases.title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez
releases.synopsis: On the Line with Alicia Menendez moves beyond the headlines to examine the stories shaping the nation, featuring one-on-one conversations with newsmakers and a focus on voices often left out of the political discourse

releases.title: Fox News @ Night
releases.synopsis: Fox News @ Night is a live hour of hard news and analysis of the most compelling stories from Washington and across the country.

releases.title: The Long Watch
releases.synopsis: A major leak case around the turn of the century strikes at the heart of cross-strait dynamics, masking a sharp battle between foreign operatives and our own forces along the covert front. In the late 1990s, an unlikely mentor-apprentice duo at Minzhou's State Security Bureau, with starkly different temperaments, are thrown together by fate to serve the same mission and faith. They manage to thwart multiple schemes, but their lives remain tangled with their enemy across a twenty-year span. As the new era reshapes the balance of power in national security, the hidden war continues without pause. Again and again tested by human nature, the three see their bonds and destinies silently transformed by the choices they make through time.

releases.title: Let's Roll, Cinnamoroll!
releases.synopsis: See what kind of activities Cinnamoroll and his friends - Chiffon, Espresso, Mocha, Milk and Cappuccino - like to do in Sucretown! Follow along in a new stop motion animation series "Let's Roll, Cinnamoroll!" every Thursday.

releases.title: Plus belle la vie, encore plus belle
The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
releases.synopsis: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.

releases.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
releases.synopsis: Reporting that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends.

releases.title: Bloomberg: The Close
releases.synopsis: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis focusing on the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street.

releases.title: Bloomberg Brief
releases.synopsis: Delivers the market news, data and analysis you need to set your agenda.

releases.title: Love with the Lion
releases.synopsis: This drama tells an inspirational story of mutual achievement and passionate dedication. Young female bodyguard Su Yuejiao and talented scholar Cheng Qi, from vastly different backgrounds, have different ambitions and styles. Forced together by chance to achieve their respective life ideals, they eventually see each other's strengths and complement each other's weaknesses. Together with the entire Su Family Escort Agency, they bravely overcome difficulties, share hardships, and defy authority, ultimately achieving their ideals and bringing prosperity to the community, thus writing a legendary tale of youthful inspiration.

releases.title: Sword God
releases.synopsis: Chief disciple Zhao Feiyang possesses the legendary "Nine Heavens Codex." When the Nether Hall wipes out the Heavenly Sword Sect, his meridians are shattered, and his fiancée even rips out his Dao bone and breaks off their engagement. At his darkest hour, he saves Bai Xi, an ancient demon saint, who grants him a saint-grade Dao bone, allowing him to cultivate again. Rising at an astonishing pace, he sets out to settle his old scores and found his own sect. A demonic sword recognizes him as its master, and even Earth Immortals submit to him. When the great tribulation finally descends, Zhao Feiyang stands defiant against fate and declares, "If Heaven demands that I face this tribulation, then I'll stain the heavens with blood!"

releases.title: City Rong
releases.synopsis: When Lian Ye, hall master of the Sanshan Gang, loses his whole family in a massacre, he teams up with childhood friend Li Mingyuan, deputy police chief of Rongcheng, and Chen Dieyi, proprietress of the Huamoli Cabaret, to investigate and avenge. They uncover a web of eerie cases spun by Japanese spy mastermind Matsui Jiiichiro to penetrate Rongcheng, battling the invaders and putting their lives on the line to protect their country.

releases.title: Alıkara
releases.synopsis: Two lives that seemed destined never to cross become bound together far more deeply than one could imagine. She is a psychologist accustomed to unraveling the feelings and hidden motives of others; he is a police commissioner used to relying on facts rather than emotions.Their relationship evolves into a complex game where intimacy gives way to estrangement and trust to doubt, and where a new secret may lie hidden behind every revelation. The past refuses to let go, their feelings intensify, and conflicting forces compel them to make difficult choices time and again.This is a story about the attraction between two strong personalities—a tale of inner conflicts, secrets, and emotions capable of altering the course of their lives.

releases.title: Good Luck Guys: Overleven zonder filter
releases.synopsis: In this program, an unexpected group of heroes embark on the adventure of a lifetime. Surviving on a deserted beach on the other side of the world. They all have some form of fame, but once on the beach that no longer matters and they have to rely on themselves. Completely outside their comfort zone, the personalities normally accustomed to luxury compete in duos.

releases.title: Bloomberg Open Interest
releases.synopsis: Delivers the market-moving news you need to know to get a jump start on the US trading day.

releases.title: The Faulkner Focus
releases.synopsis: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

releases.title: The Big Money Show
releases.synopsis: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

releases.title: The Exchange
releases.synopsis: Anchor Kelly Evans reports on the most important stories to today's markets and investors.

releases.title: ABC News Live
releases.synopsis: ABC News Live will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

releases.title: The Claman Countdown
releases.synopsis: The close of the trading day is covered.

releases.title: The Evening Edit
releases.synopsis: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

releases.title: ABC News Live Reports
releases.synopsis: ABC News Live Reports is the rare national newscast based in Los Angeles, in what the network is billing as an "outside the Beltway" focus on politics for the 2024 election cycle.

releases.title: Gladiator in the Theater
releases.synopsis: At 18, Meng Jinfu rises from a struggling opera apprentice to a Peking Opera star, pursuing his dream through hardship and changing times.

releases.title: Tut Elimi
releases.synopsis: Their paths crossed as children. Years later, a tragic incident brings Aslan and Elvan together again, forcing them into a marriage of convenience built on sacrifice and duty. At the same time, the heroes must contend with the intrigues of their relatives and pressure from influential circles.

releases.title: Мій новий берег
releases.synopsis: At 25, Galina has already become the city pole dancing champion. She works in a men's club, but is not at all ready to put up with the behavior of some visitors. Galya stands up for the dancers when clients cross the line. Because of her principled nature, Galya constantly conflicts with management, receives fines, and is increasingly in debt. It seems that getting out of this circle of problems will not be easy.Everything changes when Galya learns about the death of her own aunt. The woman leaves her a house with a land plot in the small seaside town of Lazurny Port. Galya goes there for the funeral and soon becomes the heiress.She decides not to return to her previous problems, but to use the house and land for her own business. Galya dreams of opening a hotel in Lazurny Port and building a successful business there. The new property becomes a chance for the girl to change her life.

releases.title: Truth Under The Wheel
releases.synopsis: Li Xing Chen, a former criminal investigator now working as a traffic police officer, takes on a mysterious hit-and-run case on a rainy night. Entrepreneur Gao Yu Hai is killed in the crash, but the scene has already been tampered with by someone posing as a traffic officer, erasing crucial evidence. A special task force is formed, with Li Xing Chen leading the investigation. The driver, Shen Xi, appears to have no connection to the victim, but as the investigation deepens, Li Xing Chen uncovers layer after layer of lies. Just as the case is about to be ruled a traffic accident, Xiao Ze is found hanging in a remote forest, raising new suspicions. Following the trail into the past, Li Xing Chen discovers a connection to a dance competition. On the night of a dance production, Shen Xi takes poison onstage, leaving behind a recorded message revealing the devastating abuse she suffered at the hands of the powerful. As the truth behind the rainy-night crash finally comes to light, Li Xing Chen witnesses the tragedy of ordinary people caught beneath the shadow of power—and the tangled depths of human nature hidden behind what first appeared to be an accident.

releases.title: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle
releases.synopsis: Money, Power, Politics with Stephanie Ruhle, utilizing her extensive Wall Street background to analyze the high-stakes intersection of money, power, and politics, Stephanie Ruhle delivers original reporting and hard-hitting interviews on the stories that directly affect Americans' lives. The program focuses on business and political news, featuring the "Nightcap" roundtable segment from her previous show, The 11th Hour

releases.title: ABC News Live First

Put your ear buds in for this Christian parenting podcast and get practical, faith-based inspiration through all stages of parenting — raising toddlers, navigating the school-age years, preparing for puberty, and seeing your teen soar with confidence. Hosted by Danny Huerta, in every 8 to 15 minute episode, you’ll hear parenting experts share Biblical truths, effective parenting techniques, and useful resources that will help yo

releases.title: ПинКод 2.0
releases.synopsis: Smeshariki enter a virtual reality—dangerous and beautiful. Educational adventures of beloved characters.Following the experiments of a notorious horned scientist, the Kikoriki find themselves in a virtual simulation of their world, which turns out to be a vast Metaverse. Together with the artificial intelligence Eva, the friends decide to explore this new world, experimenting with and studying the technologies of the future. It soon becomes clear that the Metaverse holds many mysteries, and escaping it isn't so easy.

releases.title: Зрадники
releases.synopsis: The show "Traitors" is an adaptation of the world hit The Traitors. The Ukrainian reality show features 22 participants competing for half a million hryvnias. Among them are "loyal" and "traitors". The task of the "loyal" is to expose the traitors, and the traitors - to reach the final. The action takes place in the Schönborn castle.

releases.title: Adam's Eight
releases.synopsis: Adam's Eight tells the remarkable true story of Karl Adam — a visionary rowing coach who, in 1950s Germany, brought together a group of underdogs and turned them into champions. Within just three years, his team defied all odds and won Olympic gold in Rome in 1960.

releases.title: Gentle Monster
releases.synopsis: After relocating with her family to the countryside, a renowned pianist uncovers a life-shattering truth that forces her to confront the complexities of love, trust, and deception.

releases.title: The Fox King
releases.synopsis: Ali and Amir are inseparable fraternal twins with a telepathic bond. The brothers are forced to fend for themselves when their father abandons them after remarrying a younger bride. The arrival of a new teacher, Lara, tests their brotherly bond.

releases.title: Istimewa
releases.synopsis: Five disabled children embark on a desperate search for their runaway foster father, only to find themselves thrust into the public eye.

releases.title: Captain Newfoundland
releases.synopsis: Media mogul, athlete, creator of the psychedelic superhero Captain Newfoundland, and an activist against his home province joining Confederation: Geoff Stirling was all these things and more. To do justice to a character as complex as this film’s protagonist, Mike Feehan turns the camera on himself and his co-director Jamie Miller as they weave together archival footage, animation, and fantastical recreations from Stirling's experimental 1970s late-night TV show, all very in keeping with NTV's original broadcast mission. Captain Newfoundland is an illuminating and wildly entertaining portrait of a complex man and his impact on the province that, according to Stirling, may or may not be the tip of the long-lost island of Atlantis.

releases.title: Billie
releases.synopsis: Nina and Angie are best friends and struggle through life together. When Angie's teenage daughter Rahel needs €300 for a school trip, they decide to go to the bank where Nina's husband Marc works to ask him for a small loan. But when Marc harshly rejects their request, Angie loses her temper. Things get out of control—and suddenly the friends are stuck in the bank and mistaken for gangsters.

releases.title: Last Train to Fortune
releases.synopsis: When schoolteacher Cecil Peachtree misses the last train to Fortune, he strikes a deal with outlaw Dooley to secure safe and timely travel.  On the journey, the two develop an odd friendship through the power of knowledge.

releases.title: Bleeding Hearts
releases.synopsis: A music-driven love story about real-life couple Zella Day and Jesse Woods, the musicians behind Chaparelle. Following their first year together, they chase a shared dream while facing pressures that could spark a breakup—or a breakthrough

releases.title: Juvenescence
releases.synopsis: An Australian coming of age comedy follows four teenagers navigating their final days at Edgewater High and all that comes with it.

releases.title: Happily Ever After
releases.synopsis: As one sister prepares for marriage and the other resists every convention it represents, their fragile bond is tested by love, family expectations, and the question of whether happiness can ever truly be chosen.

releases.title: Antarctic
releases.synopsis: A brutal crime shocks an isolated Brazilian research station in Antarctica, transforming the enviroment filled with scientists and military personnel into a veritable pressure cooker. The men at the station become suspects, and a female deputy commander takes on the mission of investigating what happened and, with the support of the women at the base, faces silence and violence in her search for justice.

releases.title: Akal Imitasi
releases.synopsis: Set in the year 2029, the story focuses on an AI-based system called PIKO in schools, and how this technology widens the gap and leads to the loss of the true essence of learning.

releases.title: Henry's First Dates
releases.synopsis: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

releases.title: Let Sleeping Dogs Lie
releases.synopsis: On the morning of his hundredth birthday, Fanny finds her grandfather dead in his bed. As she and her family are forced to deal with the death, a bitter dispute over the inheritance erupts, in which old power relations are reversed.

releases.title: FLAPJAX
releases.synopsis: An over-eager fast-food manager is tasked with reviving a highly addictive menu item called "FLAPJAX" to save his fast-food company from bankruptcy. He pulls his estranged mother, a faded pop-star known as Popo, out of retirement to promote the item. However, he soon becomes ensnared by the company's true intentions and his deeply rooted mommy issues.

releases.title: Paradise
releases.synopsis: Suleyman returns home after serving seven years, only to find his apartment block has been seized by drug dealers. When drawn into the violence surrounding the complex, his sole focus becomes keeping his mother safe.

releases.title: Godmother
releases.synopsis: A meticulously planned desert couples' vacation spirals into chaos when family tensions and a pair of mysterious hosts with devilish intentions transform a romantic getaway into a nightmare.

releases.title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 7
releases.synopsis: The seventh night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 17, 2026, at Asahikawa City General Gymnasium in Asahikawa, Hokkaido, Japan.

releases.title: Enna Vilai
releases.synopsis: A humble fisherman from Rameswaram lives a quiet life with his family until he finds a gold pendant washed ashore. What initially seems like a blessing soon turns into a nightmare when false accusations threaten his peace and dignity, forcing him to stand up against a powerful system.

releases.title: Fever
releases.synopsis: Nino is a spoiled child who, immersed by a strong fever, is absorbed by a mysterious painting. Even though his mother had warned him, the trick that made him fall prey of the painting is unleashed. And so, Nino does nothing but get lost in a maze of images trying to return home.

releases.title: Era Uma Vez Minha 1ª Vez
releases.synopsis: The first time rarely goes the way we expect—especially when we expect too much. Teresa, Clara, Tuca, and Patty are in a hurry and make a pact: lose their virginity before high school prom night. They just forgot one tiny detail: everyone moves at their own pace.

releases.title: Motherf*ckers
releases.synopsis: When Martín learns that his mother is going to marry Juan, the bully who tormented him as a child, he does what any son would do: sabotage the wedding... by sleeping with Juan's mother.

releases.title: Jollyface
releases.synopsis: The  movie follows a woman investigating a murder while being hunted in her apartment building.

releases.title: Bára - Diary of a Rockstar
releases.synopsis: Bára Basiková is an icon of Czech rock and other music genres. To what extent can her public, media-distorted image differ from the person she really is? The answer comes in the form of the latest long-term documentary study from Helena Třeštíková, whose empathy, coupled with admirable self-reflection and openness on the part of the protagonist, gives rise to a fascinating film portrait: over the course of fifty years we follow a woman who demonstrates remarkable strength as she faces the challenges of both her professional and private lives.​

releases.title: Nyepi
releases.synopsis: Tae-pyeong, Yoon-chae and their friends embark on a journey to Bali, captivated by its mystical landscapes. Their local guide, Nova, explains the significance of the upcoming Nyepi Day — Bali's sacred Day of Silence, when all forms of eating, pleasure, travel and even lights must cease. While exploring the island, Tae-pyeong accidentally breaks a mysterious urn, triggering a series of strange and terrifying events that soon force them to violate the sacred rules of Nyepi Day against their will. As reality warps around them, Tae-pyeong begins to realize that a far more sinister force is at play — one that may not let them leave the island alive.

releases.title: Nonna
releases.synopsis: Rosa, alone in her house in southern Italy which she built herself. Her children and grandchildren still live in Germany. This is not the way she thought it would be. Must she let go of her legacy?

releases.title: The Violinist
releases.synopsis: It is Singapore in the late 1930s. Kai and Fei are childhood friends and aspiring violinists. When Japan invades Malaya in 1941, Kai chooses to forgo his music career to join the anti-Japanese forces. After the war Kai goes missing. Determined to find him, Fei performs all over Southeast Asia, all the while seeking any news of Kai. Yet, as time fades, Fei has to decide if she must find her own music to define the remaining years of her life.

releases.title: After Ego
releases.synopsis: A short film by Mari Mantela.

releases.title: First They Came for My College
releases.synopsis: When the Governor of Florida transforms a beloved public honors college in a political coup, students and professors confront a new reality: their campus is ground zero in a growing nation-wide assault on academic freedom.

releases.title: Kin
releases.synopsis: After many years of actively avoiding her family, Mariia finally decides to pay them a visit, seemingly to celebrate her grandmother's jubilee. However, her intentions might not be as wholesome as it seems, as the true nature of her visit lies in the fact that the birthday girl decided to grant Mariia the ownership over her home. Mariia's uncle Grygorii learns of this and decides to engage in a turf war with his niece, hoping that this will result in the latter changing her mind. However, the young entrepeneur is a tougher nut to crack than it initially looks.

releases.title: Frost Without Snow and Ice
releases.synopsis: Over a decade on Svalbard, the fastest warming place on earth, Norwegian filmmaker Asgeir Helgestad witnesses the extraordinary life of a polar bear named Frost – a mother struggling to raise her cubs in a rapidly changing Arctic. This intimate journey transforms him from observer to storyteller, driven by his passion to connect with nature and to expose the devastating impacts of climate change on this fragile ecosystem.

releases.title: The Secret Lives of Suburban Housewives
releases.synopsis: When one couple moves to suburbia, they realize their neighbors are hiding more than a few scandals. After a shocking death rattles the neighborhood, lies and revelations come to surface as a killer races against time to keep their secret buried for good.

releases.title: Urang Bunian: Misteri dari Hutan Sumatera
releases.synopsis: On their way to his wife's hometown in West Sumatra, Teddy and his best friend, Kevin, recklessly continue their journey at night and become lost in a forbidden area believed to be the realm of the Urang Bunian. Amidst a forest filled with supernatural terrors and illusions, they must find their way home before they disappear forever.

releases.title: Shish Doo
releases.synopsis: Over the course of one night, two friends, Adel and Nabil, find an unconscious wealthy young man and decide to kidnap him for ransom to escape poverty and despair. As events escalate, the kidnappers’ interests become entangled with the young man’s family and a powerful man who exploits his disappearance, revealing class conflicts, power struggles, and moral collapse.

releases.title: 10éjszakás kaland
releases.synopsis: Instead of ten commandments, ten intertwined Tinder dates: virtual relationships, bleak joys, fast-paced moves, spiritual deviance, hypocritical hypocrisy, perverse homophobia, lustful bloody revenge, and in the background a surprising twist that is far from being about joys...  This boundary-pushing independent film is not a traditional romantic story, but an experimental, provocative look at the 2020s, where the search for happiness is often just a swipe right away, yet it seems unattainable.

releases.title: Letter
releases.synopsis: A young surgeon accompanies a group of communists from the Chechen-Ingush Autonomous Soviet Socialist Republic secretly carrying a letter to L.I. Brezhnev in 1972. The story, which changed the fate of a nation, is based on true events.

releases.title: Children of the Monkey
releases.synopsis: Dario, father of a disabled child, begins to receive attention from his brother's teenage son, discovering that he prefers him to his own. In the growing complicity with his nephew he finds the son he would have liked to have, he takes on the role of the father he could have been. An illusory and dangerous role-playing game that will put the entire family at risk.

releases.title: 9 Temples to Heaven
releases.synopsis: After a fortune teller warns him that his elderly mother may die soon, Sakol (63) sets out on a one-day pilgrimage to nine temples as a remedy. Just two weeks before her birthday, he brings his ailing mother, along with his wife, brother, sister, and children, on the trip amid the splendor of Thai architecture. From temple to temple, the nine family members are forced to bridge their clashes, while the grandmother grows physically and mentally weary.

releases.title: Deep Hallows - A Brazilian Gothic Fable
releases.synopsis: The small town of Furnas Fundas hides a secret far older than its pastures, forests, or the people who live there. During a heated election marred by scandals, Bartira, known merely as the town drunk, unexpectedly finds herself at the center of it all. It’s up to her to face a dark force that has returned to turn the town into a true bloodbath.

releases.title: Мой Север
releases.synopsis: The life of the capital's engineer Viktor falls apart after a visit to a northern shaman - Viktor's family dies. Time passes. Escaping from guilt, Viktor decides to build a wind power plant in the North, but the project is in danger of failure due to the inexplicable forces of the North.

releases.title: Sugar
releases.synopsis: A salon owner and young mother navigates life with her increasingly abusive partner.

releases.title: Mein Surname
releases.synopsis: David J. Hitler, burdened by his notorious surname, attempts to prove he's a good person but quickly discovers that redemption is a harder sell than infamy.

releases.title: Family Album
releases.synopsis: Alex will soon become a father. In a storage room, he discovers deeply disturbing family photographs. Some suggest his mother’s marital infidelity; others indicate his father, a retired officer, was involved in various acts of violence. Alex’s investigation leads him to a town devastated years before by the violence of the Internal Armed Conflict, where he uncovers his true and intricate family album.

releases.title: I Have Proof
releases.synopsis: Plot details are being kept locked in an old VCR, but the film is said to be psychologically charged, and favor 'texture, imperfection, and immediacy over polish'.

releases.title: The Tale of Fairy Tales
releases.synopsis: Modern-day Ivan dislikes fairy tales and doesn't believe in them. One day, he accidentally falls into a magic chest and finds himself in a world of fairy tales. To return home, Ivan must confront evil spirits, make friends, and accomplish a truly heroic feat.

releases.title: Ася выходит из зоны комфорта
releases.synopsis: An agoraphobic young accountant is trying to choose between the perfect guy in her apartment or the imperfect guy next door, the only problem is the perfect guy in her apartment is imaginary.

releases.title: The Sign of the Dragon
releases.synopsis: Detective Michael loses his hearing during an operation and subsequently withdraws from active duty. Years later, a former colleague asks him to take on a mysterious case involving a dangerous dragon cult. Despite his limitations, he is called back into action and must confront his past in order to solve the case.

releases.title: Death of a Yellow Bird
releases.synopsis: A terminally ill man returns to his childhood home searching for closure. While there he discovers, buried in the earth, the family’s long lost VHS camera. Inside the camera he finds a video tape of home movies. But as he watches, something disturbing begins bleeding through the static.

releases.title: HALF
releases.synopsis: Twin half-blooded vampires wage war with desert highway hijackers.

releases.title: Und es war Sommer - Dieter Thomas Kuhn & Band
Phreaker
releases.synopsis: Inspired by true events. Before there were hackers, there were phreakers. A blind teenager joins the early underworld of "phone freaks" where he learns to hack his way to money, power, and eventually, a place on the FBI's most wanted list.

releases.title: You Won't Believe What Happened Before
releases.synopsis: Two rogue journalists clash over a damning video that could topple a crooked regime. As betrayal and blackmail mount, their twisted road trip spirals into chaos, murder, and a scandal that could bring the whole system crashing down.

releases.title: Terbang
releases.synopsis: The story of the country's legendary rallyer, Karamjit Singh (shortled "Flying Sikh"). His plot focuses on his rise, great sacrifices, and the never-fafeated fighting spirit to make Malaysia proud in the international motorsports scene.

releases.title: Lover, Not a Fighter
releases.synopsis: Andrej has a secret plan – to see no one, meet no one, only talk to his grandma and not climb high trees while being drunk. Then he unexpectedly encounters Miša, at whom he previously tried to smile 17 times while being drunk at parties. He never remembered the outcome as he was always too drunk, but not today. Today he is sober. Andrej and Miša start to talk and over the glass of Fanta find an interest in each other. The fight for their young and tender love begins.

releases.title: Cancelled
releases.synopsis: Acclaimed director Danny Ben-Moshe turns his lens to Australia’s arts sector in Cancelled, examining the experience of Jewish creatives following October 7.  With urgency and compassion, the film follows musician Deborah Conway, visual artist Nina Sanadze, writer Joshua Dabelstein and circus artist Talia Sofizade as they navigate a rapidly shifting environment, culminating in the Bondi terror attack. Documenting their artistic practices and resilience in real time, the film forges an intimate portrait of a community and a wider reflection on the proliferation of antisemitism in the arts sector, exposing its implications on cultural life, freedom of expression and social cohesion.

releases.title: Under the Gaze of Night
releases.synopsis: Set in a park at night during the pandemic, the story follows a gay man who suffers from an intense fear of AIDS. This fear isolates him and prevents him from engaging in sexual relationships, yet he is drawn to the park’s charged atmosphere of desire. The park, a known cruising spot for gay men, becomes a place where he encounters a range of strangers — each searching, escaping, or surrendering in the shadows.

releases.title: Aeternus Florere
releases.synopsis: A short film.

releases.title: Look At Me!
releases.synopsis: Synopsis TBA

releases.title: No More History Without Us
releases.synopsis: Submerged in the sea of greenwashing that drowns them daily, two Amazonian filmmakers have decided to denounce, in this film manifesto, the entrails of the historical process of inventing and exploiting the forest as an inexhaustible Garden of Eden. Between Munich and Belém, they reveal how racism and prejudice, in Brazil and throughout the world, are still organised around the idea of a “savage demographic emptiness”, unable to speak for itself.

releases.title: Stonewalling
releases.synopsis: After experiencing the classic meet-cute, Dean discovers an unexplainable force that keeps him from making contact with Anika. As each creative attempt to bypass the barrier takes a physically depleting toll on him, Dean must realize the unchangeable nature of their fate.

releases.title: Beporoya
releases.synopsis: The return of Adrit Roy.

releases.title: La guerre des Gaules : César nous a-t-il menti ?
Into the Sky
releases.synopsis: A man's efforts to win back his wife keep getting derailed when aliens mysteriously snatch him from Earth, making his path to reconciliation a lot more complicated than expected.

releases.title: The Art Class
releases.synopsis: This film tells the story of Class 4, Grade 9—a notorious “last-place class” at school due to its high number of failing students. Their leader, Ba Wang Chaoguo, is seen as the ringleader of this so-called “herd.” One day, the school brings in a highly unconventional art teacher whose eccentric methods baffle the administration but unexpectedly inspire Ba Wang and his classmates, giving them a new sense of purpose and hope for the future.

releases.title: There Will Be Light
releases.synopsis: There Will Be Light is the first documentary in Taiwan to focus on a site recognized for its significance to transitional justice. Centering on Gikong Presbyterian Church, the first citizen-nominated site officially designated by the Ministry of Culture, the film revisits one of the darkest chapters of Taiwan’s authoritarian era—the 1980 Lin Family Massacre.

releases.title: The Heretiks
releases.synopsis: On Halloween night, a disaffected teenage girl must team up with a renegade witch to protect her little sister from a murderous coven hellbent on sacrificing her in an apocalyptic ritual.

releases.title: Is This Life?
releases.synopsis: A group of young adults, Navigate love, identity, self-destruction while trying to survive their twenties in a world that constanlty makes them feel no enough.

releases.title: Ekeko: El Muñeco de la Suerte
releases.synopsis: The story follows Gabriela, a young woman seeking to heal the deep wounds of a traumatic past. In her desperation, she decides to invoke a traditional Ekeko doll to heal and change her destiny. However, what initially seems to bring her good fortune soon transforms into her worst nightmare. The plot explores how the unbridled pursuit of prosperity distorts the amulet's essence when it interacts with Taitaorco, a powerful mountain spirit. Under the stark premise that "greed is a deadly sin" and "every stroke of luck comes at a price," a sinister ancestral rule is revealed: if the cigarette offered to the statuette goes out before burning completely, a portal to the underworld (Uku Pacha) opens, awakening malevolent entities ready to violently collect on favors rendered in exchange for your very soul.

releases.title: How to Survive Hollywood
releases.synopsis: A struggling actress gets one last shot at her Hollywood dream - with just one hour to turn an unreleased Dutch movie into a $100 million sequel to "Babygirl."

releases.title: Bruca Braca Bruda Brada - Zombie Apocalypse
releases.synopsis: The year is 2045: humanity has almost conquered death, but some parts of the world still haven't solved the parking problem. The most powerful politician in a Sarajevo municipality has decided to implement a controversial idea and build a parking lot on the site of an old local cemetery. Of course, this is just the last straw.

releases.title: Surrr naks klik
releases.synopsis: A short film by Roosa Vuokkola.

releases.title: Thomas & Friends: Really Helpful Engines
releases.synopsis: Around every bend on Sodor, there is someone who needs help and a problem to solve. And no one is more excited to help than Thomas! Join Thomas and his friends for exciting adventures, unexpected surprises, and songs you will be singing long after the journey ends. Because every delivery, every challenge, and every adventure is better when friends work together.

releases.title: Descendants of Niue
releases.synopsis: Stories of Niue follows the journey of preservation and celebration of Niuean culture, language, and heritage, highlighting the voices and stories of the island's local community navigating life in Niue and the diaspora.

releases.title: Big Daddy’s Flowers
releases.synopsis: A flower delivery driver becomes involved in the business of a mysterious crime boss.

releases.title: Before We Leave Tuscany
releases.synopsis: A weary mother seeking solace retreats to a serene Tuscan villa, where the adorable Italian innkeeper and a handsome novelist with writer's block, draw her into a story of unexpected connection and renewal.

releases.title: The Last Season
releases.synopsis: Alan, a promising boxer, spends a lonely summer traveling with his family’s carnival. Trapped among the flashing lights of the carnival rides, he dreams of a life that would bring him more freedom and recognition. When he meets lifeguard Viki during his last summer shift at the lake, an unexpected bond forms between them that helps them both find the courage to set out in a new direction. After failing her college entrance exams, Viki is coming to terms with her disappointment and searching for her own path. The summer at Zemplínska Šírava gives her the space to defy the expectations of those around her, leave the past behind, and start believing in herself.

releases.title: Les 100 pubs les plus cultes : spécial années 90
The Class: Online
releases.synopsis: A group of college students reunite for a late-night online class after the events of The Class. What starts as a normal session begins to feel off when strange glitches and eerie occurrences appear on their screens.

releases.title: Pierre-Yves prend le métro
releases.synopsis: In an immersive quest through the Montreal Metro, Pierre-Yves Lord dives into the history, hidden spots, and key highlights of one of North America’s largest metro systems.

releases.title: My Death Wife
releases.synopsis: khmer movie

releases.title: Love and Katsom
releases.synopsis: A Vanuatu-New Zealand documentary following real-life couple Kersom and Benina as they navigate modern romance and traditional kastom around their wedding.

releases.title: Decepciones del Alma (La Agonía de la Soledad)
releases.synopsis: A Christmas story set in Argentina in '98, alternating with that same family's memories of 1968—a year that marked them forever.

releases.title: That Photo In My Wallet
releases.synopsis: A lonely teenage girl struggles to navigates an overwhelming sense of isolation that alienates the people closest to her.

releases.title: Everything Happens All the Time
releases.synopsis: Through twenty-seven interviews, street footage, and photographs, this film explores the relationship between street photographers, their practice, and one another in the community that has formed around the genre in London.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: KYOTO lo sguardo del drago
releases.synopsis: Un fantasy thriller, come in un film, dal lusso degli yacht di Portofino ai ruderi di un antico castello in Giappone. Il prezioso pugnale del samurai demone Nobunaga è scomparso. Michele, geniale decifratore di codici segreti, Alexander, affascinante milionario irlandese, Gretel, eclettica signora, e Yoshida, investigatore privato, sono i fantastici quattro che indagano per svelare il mistero in un crescendo da vivere minuto dopo minuto: gli azzardi, i ninja, l'onore e l'amicizia, l'amore e la morte. Tragica e fiabesca, cinica e poetica, una storia dura ammantata di dolcezza ed elegante ironia fino alla spietata soluzione.

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.title: The Beeston Genesis
releases.synopsis: A historical and analytical study examining the role of Robert William Felkin in the formation and codification of modern Western Tarot systems. The paper situates Felkin’s work within the intellectual and social context of Beeston, Nottinghamshire, and traces how these early influences informed later Golden Dawn Tarot structures.

releases.title: My Terrible, Horrible, No Good, Very Bad Dad
releases.synopsis: This work serves as the primary case study for Sir Jacob Kristopher Anders' research into Digital Provenance and Media Ethics (Ref: Wikidata Q138334536).

releases.title: A Good Person
releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?

releases.title: In the Periphery of It All
This House Will Feed

Amidst the devastation of Ireland’s Great Famine, a young woman is salvaged from certain death when offered a mysterious position at a remote manor house haunted by a strange power and the horror of her own memories in this chillingly evocative historical novel braided with gothic horror and supernatural suspense for readers of Katherine Arden’s The Warm Hands of Ghosts and The Silence Factory by Bridget Collins.

County Clare, 1848: In the scant few years since the potato blight first cast its foul shadow over Ireland, Maggie O’Shaughnessy has lost everything—her entire family and the man she trusted with her heart. Toiling in the Ennis Workhouse for paltry rations, she can see no future either within or outside its walls—until the mysterious Lady Catherine arrives to whisk her away to an old mansion in the stark limestone landscape of the Burren.

Lady Catherine wants Maggie to impersonate her late daughter, Wilhelmina, and hoodwink solicitors into releasing Wilhelmina’s widow pension so that Lady Catherine can continue to provide for the villagers in her care. In exchange, Maggie will receive freedom from the workhouse, land of her own, and the one thing she wants more than a chance to fulfill the promise she made to her brother on his deathbed—to live to spite them all.

Launching herself into the daunting task, Maggie plays the role of Wilhelmina as best she can while ignoring the villagers’ tales of ghostly figures and curses. But more worrying are the whispers that come from within. Something in Lady Catherine’s house is reawakening long-buried memories in Maggie—of a foe more terrifying than hunger or greed, of a power that calls for blood and vengeance, and of her own role in a nightmare that demands the darkest sacrifice . . .

यह महज़ एक प्रेम कहानी नहीं है, बल्कि नफरत की आग से शुरू होकर सजदों की शांति तक पहुँचने वाला एक गहरा सफ़र है. फ़ैज़ की गलतियाँ उसे ऐसी गलियों में ले जाती हैं जहाँ पछतावा ही उसका इकलौता साथी है
